relationship_description: Arnulfo Fuentebella is the father of Felix William 'Wimpy' Fuentebella, both members of the Fuentebella political dynasty in Camarines Sur.
Arnulfo Fuentebella is married to Evelyn Fuentebella, who has also held political office in Camarines Sur.
Arnulfo Fuentebella is the son of Felix Fuentebella, a former Speaker of the House and patriarch of the Fuentebella dynasty.
